question: Can a compressed, winsorized and strictly balanced Broker Supply + Service segmentation improve over the legacy Broker without the 98% cluster collapse?
hypothesis: Dominant specialization, diversity/entropy and robust scale features will yield balanced Broker profiles and preserve or improve AP/lift.
primary_change: replace legacy broker_profile with strictly balanced broker_supply_balanced_profile and broker_service_balanced_profile
secondary_changes: compress high-dimensional shares into dominant categories plus entropy
fail hard if selected Broker profile is unbalanced

target.censoring: Public candidate data has no true sale timestamp; offline result is associative.

population.eligibility: Same E006/E007 temporal population and untouched future test.
exclusions: Profile-calibration rows excluded from predictive fit.

validation.strategy: same temporal train/future-test; outcome-free cluster selection; paired cluster-bootstrap by lead_id
validation.split_description: Identical E006 future test; model family/hyperparameters held fixed.

items.evidence: No mutable current-state spot aggregates; uses dominant sector/modality/region, diversity and robust log scale.
broker_response_hours is excluded; only past outcomes and inquiry characteristics are used.
